messages:
maria: seeing a recurring p99 latency spike on node group `dedicated-gpu-3` during sustained long-context chatter, looks correlated with a burst of KV eviction activity. flamegraph: https://perf.internal.redwood/gh/17321/flame.svg. baseline before spike was ~28ms, jumps to 420ms for a few seconds.
aj: can you paste the exact log window and the config for eviction policy on that pool? FIFO or LRU setting?
maria: pool is configured as `fifo` with probation window 2s, hotset threshold 0.6. log snippet below showing evicter churn: ```[2026-02-24T15:12:03Z] evict start batch=128 reclaimed=0 high_water=0.85
[2026-02-24T15:12:03Z] rotate evicter: victim slab=7 batch=128
[2026-02-24T15:12:03Z] evict end reclaimed=4 pause=1ms
[2026-02-24T15:12:03Z] pager swap kickoff fallback_to_disk=true
```
kevin: interesting: the profiler shows a syscall spike waiting on page reclaim + lock contention in `kv_map::reinsert()`. snippet from perf:`top 5 stacks: kv_map::reinsert -> evicter::try_reclaim -> pager::swap -> runtime::serve_request`
sylvia: could be an ordering/reinsert race where FIFO reinserts tombstones in an order that thrashes the pager under high long-context allocation. we've seen similar with a skewed TTL distribution.
aj: can you repro with the stress harness? command I use: `./tooling/stress_kv --clients 120 --ctx-len 64k --pattern long-tail --duration 600s --policy=fifo`
maria: launching that now on canary 3. I'll also flip a canary to `lru` to compare.
runtime-bot: deploy canary started by maria at commit cbd13f3 to pool dedicated-gpu-3-canary (instances:3). health checks passing.
kevin: if LRU reduces reinserts it should bring p99 down. quick experiment patch: reduce probation window to 200ms and limit batch size to 64 to reduce IO bursts. patch gist: https://stash.internal/redwood/evicter/patch/324
sylvia: i'll run the harness locally with the same seed and attach perf scripts. also want to capture heap profiles across the long-context to check fragmentation. use: `RUNTIME_HEAPPROFILE=1 ./stress_kv ...`
maria: after flipping to lru on canary, p99 dropped to 62ms, throughput steady. fifo canary still shows spikes. i captured a heap diff and there is a small but growing fragmentation bitmap in slab 7 during the spike window. uploading artifacts to /tmp/artifacts/1732105555.zip
aj: great, next steps: 1) reproduce deterministically with harness and seed, 2) run kevin's reduced-batch patch on fifo to confirm mitigation, 3) add an assertion/metric around reclaim latency so alerts are clearer. can someone own the repro? :point_up:
sylvia: i'll own repro and heap diffs, will post results in this thread in ~2 hours.
maria: thanks! i'll keep the canary toggles and the artifact link. tagging @kevin for a quick follow-up on the patch if repro is stable. :thumbsup:
